note: The identifiers of the stack bus of HYDRA-UMC (STACK A). A message of a controller board has the identifier slot_base + slot * slot_window + offset; the emergency stop is one identifier for the whole stack, below every slot. Each identifier has one emitter. The firmware, its host tools and HYDRA-UMC-TELEMETRY-COLLECTOR read this document; nothing here has run on a board.
